single.rationale: Arcosa shows strong fundamental improvement with revenue growing 12% and operating margin recovering sharply from 7.6% to 11.9% in FY2025. The $1.2B Stavola acquisition positions the company in the attractive NY-NJ metro market, and infrastructure tailwinds from IIJA funding through 2026 plus data center/grid buildout provide multi-year secular support. Strong free cash flow generation ($175M, up from $312M in 2024 after normalizing for working capital swings) and reasonable leverage post-acquisition suggest operational execution is improving despite cyclical exposure.
